Poetry.t: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:
My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
Open rebuke is better than secret love.
He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.
Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
A Song or Psalm of David. O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
SAMECH. I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?
Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.
Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.
Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:
When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
HE. Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.
Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.
He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:
But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
Many seek the ruler's favour; but every man's judgment cometh from the LORD.
Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:
The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD'S throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.
Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.
The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.
O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man's heart discerneth both time and judgment.
Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.
His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
A Psalm of David. Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.
He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.
He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.
Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.
The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
My beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.
But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.
Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.
Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.
This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.
For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?
Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.
Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.
Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.
He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.
He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
A Psalm of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.
Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.
The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.
God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.
In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.
LAMED. For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;
I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.
I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.
Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.
Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.
Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David. Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?
Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.
Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.
Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.
He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.
But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.
Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.
Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.
I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?
For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.
The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.
Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

Major Prophets.t: The meek also shall increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?
But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.
Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:
I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, in the province of Babylon.
Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God.
Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD.
Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.
And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.
As for our redeemer, the LORD of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.
Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
For thus saith the LORD to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.
He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
Thou, O king, art a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.
Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when he led thee by the way?
And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
And I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:
He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.
For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.
He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
I, even I, am the LORD; and beside me there is no saviour.
And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.
O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:
Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
That the LORD thy God may shew us the way wherein we may walk, and the thing that we may do.
A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.
